@everyone Meeting Recap, Wednesday, September 9th:

Introduction to Astrophysics Club plus a lesson on NASA's newly launched Nancy Grace Roman Space Telescope, covering how it finds exoplanets through gravitational microlensing and how it will map dark energy.

Slides and notes: https://fhsastrophysics.github.io/fhs-astrophysics/#meeting-2627-1

NEXT MEETING: Wednesday, September 23rd in the Fair Oaks Room, featuring guest speaker Dr. Seth Shostak, Senior Astronomer at the SETI Institute! He co-hosts the weekly Big Picture Science radio show, has testified before Congress on the search for extraterrestrial life, given a TED talk on whether ET is out there, and written books like Confessions of an Alien Hunter. Don't miss out!

Have a great week everybody we hope to see you soon!

@everyone Meeting Recap, Wednesday, September 23rd:

Today we were lucky enough to host Dr. Seth Shostak, Senior Astronomer at the SETI Institute, for a talk and live Q&A on the search for extraterrestrial intelligence. We got into how SETI actually listens for signals, the Drake equation, the Fermi paradox, and why he thinks we could find a signal within a couple of decades. Huge thanks to Dr. Shostak for coming out.

Slides and notes: https://fhsastrophysics.github.io/fhs-astrophysics/#meeting-2627-2

NEXT MEETING: Wednesday, October 7th in Room 91. We've got something in the works, details coming soon.

Thanks to everyone who came out, see you next time!
